note: Series definitions only: no values. Values enter by owner-attested manual import of official releases. Automated EIA / World Bank access is blocked pending owner decision U2; SBP automation is blocked (HTTP 403, permission R3).

series.name: SBP policy rate
series.definition: Policy (target) rate announced in the SBP monetary policy statement; reference period = effective date.

series.name: 6-month KIBOR (offer)
series.definition: 6-month Karachi Interbank Offered Rate, offer side, as published by SBP.

series.name: PKR per USD, interbank
series.definition: Interbank closing or weighted-average rate as published by SBP (record which in the import note).

series.name: SBP liquid foreign exchange reserves
series.definition: Liquid FX reserves held by SBP, week-ending figure.

series.name: National CPI inflation, year on year
series.definition: National CPI general index, YoY change, PBS monthly release.

series.name: Brent crude spot
series.definition: Europe Brent spot price FOB, as published by EIA.

series.name: Urea (World Bank Pink Sheet)
series.definition: Monthly urea price as published in the World Bank commodity price data (Pink Sheet); record the grade/location the release states.

series.name: Coal (World Bank Pink Sheet)
series.definition: Monthly coal price as published in the World Bank commodity price data; record the grade/location the release states.
